Name: Haley HD portrait for portraiture
Author: ffzzyyy
Description:
This is a Haley portrait I made.Hope you guys like it!  If you have any recommendations you want me to fix be sure to let me know.
You MUST have the following mods installed:
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture
[/url]
How to install:

find the rar/zip file called FFC's Haley Portrait

unzip it

place the file into Stardew Valley/mods/portraiture/Portraits


发型是根据原版像素肖像修改的，让它看起来更好看，更高清同时让面部更精致。
